entities.summary: Abdullah Gül University (AGU) is a public university located in Kayseri, Turkey. Established in 2010, the university began admitting students in the 2013–2014 academic year. AGU offers twelve undergraduate and eleven graduate programs across five schools. The university’s primary language of instruction is English, a characteristic shared with a limited number of other public universities in Turkey, including Middle East Technical University, Boğaziçi University and İzmir Institute of Technology.
